allow..mcpbignore: mcpb pack reads its ignore file from the package root, like .npmignore for npm.
allow..npmignore: npm pack reads the ignore file from the package root; curates the published tarball alongside package.json files.
allow.hooks: Source for the optional socket-gate Claude Code hook; rolldown bundles hooks/socket-gate into dist/socket-gate (scripts/repo/paths.mts SOCKET_GATE_SRC_DIR).
allow.icon.png: MCPB extension icon; manifest.json references it by root-relative path ("icon": "icon.png").
allow.index.ts: MCP server entry point; rolldown.config.mts bundles REPO_ROOT/index.ts into dist/index.cjs, the package bin.
allow.lib: TypeScript source tree imported by index.ts and the socket-gate hook; bundled into dist/ at build.
allow.logo-black.png: Socket logo referenced by README.md's root-relative picture srcset, rendered on GitHub and npm.
allow.logo-white.png: Socket logo (dark mode) referenced by README.md's root-relative picture srcset, rendered on GitHub and npm.
allow.manifest.json: MCPB (Claude extension) manifest; the mcpb packer requires it at the package root and its entry_point/icon paths resolve from there.
allow.mock-client: Local MCP debug clients (stdio/http) used to exercise the server during development; documented in mock-client/README.md.
